actions.result: The working schedule appeared as an editable weekly grid with shift-add cells and a prominent Publish action.
A separate Published Schedules screen displayed a historical schedule card with an explicit 'Published' label, publication timestamp, and green status/icon treatment.

observations.expected: Draft and published schedules are visually distinct
observations.observed: The draft/workspace uses an editable grid and Publish controls, while the historical schedule is isolated in a Published view and carries an explicit green Published status.

notes: Draft editing and published history use clearly different views, controls, and status styling.
isolation: Fresh Vite process on case-unique loopback origin http://127.0.0.1:4727; origin-scoped local/session storage cannot carry over from other cases.
